 St. Francis seniors recall 1957 Braves World Series
 Few fans know baseball heart and history like our seniors. Fans remember the magic of the Milwaukee Braves 1957 World Series win. Brewer fever has no age limit – and the fans who have been repping the Cream City the longest are bringing the most energy.
